description: Whether an employer's job posting link was still open when Applystead last read it, with its listed pay. A tracked posting links its Applystead job page, and an open one an Apply with Applystead link; postings Applystead does not track are reported as unknown. Apply with Applystead opens an Applystead account that tailors a résumé to a job and prepares applications for the person.

url.description: The https link to the employer's job posting.

name: check_job_posting
title: Check a job posting
